# CodeBase.NET corpus VFP value oracle
# Written by test-files-generator/vfp/vfpfunc.prg in Visual FoxPro 9.
# Do not edit by hand; re-run the script in the VM instead.
#
# VFPFVAL.DBF IS THE ORACLE. A numeric result is stored in RESD, a
# Double, and the text below is a formatting of it -- if the two ever
# disagree the field wins. RESLEN carries the true length of a
# character result, because the C(80) field pads.
table        VFPFVAL.DBF
producer     "Visual FoxPro 09.00.0000.5815 for Windows [Oct 15 2007 09:11:06] Product ID 76683-335-9735121-18548"
codePage     1251
collate      MACHINE
century      OFF
rollover     29
count        77

  main       INT(-0.5)                      -> 0.000000000000   (display only, RESD is the bits)

  main       ROUND(-2.5,0)                  -> -3.000000000000   (display only, RESD is the bits)
  main       ROUND(0.125,2)                 -> 0.130000000000   (display only, RESD is the bits)   ; the double is exact
  main       ROUND(0.135,2)                 -> 0.140000000000   (display only, RESD is the bits)   ; the double is below
  main       ROUND(12345.6789,3)            -> 12345.679000000000   (display only, RESD is the bits)

  main       MIN("A","B")                   -> "A" len=1   ; the string overload
  main       MAX("A","B")                   -> "B" len=1
  main       MIN(1,2,3)                     -> 1.000000000000   (display only, RESD is the bits)   ; three parameters
  main       AT("Z","AB")                   -> 0.000000000000   (display only, RESD is the bits)   ; not found
